_comment: Written by tools/build-should-i-grade.mjs (Wildcard, BET-20261102-1). Standard vs Value break-even on the tool's cards; read by tools/build-grade-premiums.mjs.
line: PSA Value is open again: $39.99 a card for cards declared at $500 or less (PSA’s change of Oct 29, 2026; fees read Nov 3, 2026). Of the 974 cards we can run, 626 have a median of $500 or less as a PSA 10. At Value instead of Standard, 592 of them break even at a lower PSA 10 rate, and for the 451 that needed between 1% and 100% at Standard, the median break-even falls from 35% to 17%. Another 67 that didn’t pay even on a 10 at Standard now break even below 100%.
